info.name: CEVCMS EPIC-6 QA-005 Core Chain
info.description: Sanitized dynamic QA-005 backend/API chain. Supply only local synthetic runtime credentials and variables; no credential, token, key, signature, or personal data is stored in this file.

exec: pm.test('Admin login succeeds',()=>{ pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.role).to.eql('Admin'); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken',b.access_token); pm.collectionVariables.set('nationalId',`QA005-${pm.variables.get('runId')}`); });

pm.test('Admin profile is database-backed',()=>{ pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.role).to.eql('Admin'); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminUserId',b.user_id); });

pm.test('Farmer is created with generated FIN',()=>{ pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.farmer_id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(b.fin_code).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('farmerId',b.farmer_id); pm.collectionVariables.set('finCode',b.fin_code); });

pm.test('Polygon Farm persists calculated demonstration fields',()=>{ pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.farmer_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('farmerId'))); pm.expect(b.geometry.type).to.eql('Polygon'); pm.expect(b.area_hectares).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(b.eudr_risk_flag).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.collectionVariables.set('farmId',b.farm_id); });

pm.test('Lot is created with server-controlled fields',()=>{ pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.farm_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('farmId'))); pm.expect(b.created_by).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('adminUserId'))); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('created'); pm.expect(b.gin_code).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('lotId',b.lot_id); pm.collectionVariables.set('ginCode',b.gin_code); });

pm.test('Initial lot_created event is present',()=>{ pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.lot.lot_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('lotId'))); pm.expect(b.events).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(b.events[0].event_type).to.eql('lot_created'); pm.expect(b.events[0].recorded_by).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('adminUserId'))); pm.collectionVariables.set('initialEventId',b.events[0].event_id); });

pm.test('Appended event persists with server identity',()=>{ pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.lot_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('lotId'))); pm.expect(b.recorded_by).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('adminUserId'))); pm.expect(b.event_type).to.eql('qa005_trace_appended'); pm.collectionVariables.set('appendedEventId',b.event_id); });

pm.test('Trace links one ordered QA005 chain',()=>{ pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.farmer.farmer_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('farmerId'))); pm.expect(b.farm.farm_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('farmId'))); pm.expect(b.lot.gin_code).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('ginCode')); pm.expect(b.events.map(e=>e.event_type)).to.eql(['lot_created','qa005_trace_appended']); pm.expect(b.events.map(e=>e.event_id)).to.eql([Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('initialEventId')),Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('appendedEventId'))]); });

pm.test('First QR generation is minimized',()=>{ pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.qr_id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(b.verification_url).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(b.image_svg).to.match(/^data:image\/svg\+xml;base64,/); pm.expect(b.image_png_data_url).to.match(/^data:image\/png;base64,/); const raw=JSON.stringify(b); ['payload_hash','hmac_signature','canonical_payload'].forEach(k=>pm.expect(raw).not.to.include(k)); const m=b.verification_url.match(/[?&]sig=([^&]+)/); pm.expect(m).to.not.equal(null); pm.collectionVariables.set('qrId',b.qr_id); pm.collectionVariables.set('qrSignature',m[1]); });

pm.test('Public verification is valid and minimized',()=>{ pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('valid'); pm.expect(b.gin_code).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('ginCode')); const raw=JSON.stringify(b); ['national_id','phone_number','geometry','payload_hash','hmac_signature','signature','access_token'].forEach(k=>pm.expect(raw).not.to.include(k)); });
